newsitem.title: USA: Entergy 836 MW Arkansas nuke seen up Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Entergy 836 MW Arkansas nuke seen up Sunday.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 836 megawatt Arkansas nuclear power unit 1 was expected to restart production Sunday from a maintenance outage which began in September, a company spokesman said.
"It should be back on line this weekend, we're looking at Sunday," spokesman Terry Young said Thursday.
The Russellville, Ark., unit was taken off line September 12 for a scheduled 30-day refueling and maintenance outage.
The 858 megawatt Arkansas nuclear power unit 2, also at Russellville, was operating normally at close to full capacity, the spokesman said.
